title: Modder pumps liquid directly over bare GPU silicon via 3D-printed block — drops RTX 2060 Super load temps to 28°C despite initial leaks
summary: The fearless TrashBench has been testing direct die water cooling of graphics cards. Our hardware adventurer covered any surface-mount components beside the GPU with nail polish to prevent water damage/shorting.
